step: ADR-015 follow-up item 4 — last-reseller-administrator protection (migration 0030, reseller-admin-liveness.ts, revoke and disable)
usage: source the DATABASE_* environment of a test template database at migration 0024 or later (acc_r015_base), then: node scripts/mutation/run.mjs scripts/mutation/catalogue/item4-0030.json --out <dir>. Every DB command first applies the (mutated) migrations to its disposable clone.

argv: npm run db:migrate --workspace @acc/db && cd apps/api && npx jest --selectProjects security --runInBand --forceExit --testPathPatterns reseller-admin-liveness

mutants.title: trigger removed: DELETE of a reseller-administrator grant is unguarded

edits.search:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_roles_reseller_admin_liveness
  AFTER DELETE ON "user_roles"
  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.scope_type = 'reseller')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_user_roles_reseller_admin_guard();

mutants.killedBy: D: owner/acc_app deleting the last grant is refused; A: three triggers pinned

mutants.title: trigger removed: UPDATE of a reseller-administrator grant is unguarded

  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.scope_type = 'reseller')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_user_roles_reseller_admin_guard();
